# DeepTip

> DeepTip is a UI design pattern: explanation windows with depth (nested, pinnable tooltips like in Paradox Interactive's games). Rest on an element and a window explains it; highlighted terms open further windows; a click pins them; pinned windows contain terms again. Content is data: one JSON glossary per language with [[key]] links. This repository holds the specification, the glossary schema and validator, shared test cases and one implementation per framework.

Synonyms: DeepTooltip, 3DTooltip, DimTip, nested tooltips, Paradox tooltips, tooltips in tooltips, Erklärfenster. The specification is the contract; the web runtime is the reference implementation.

## Docs

- [Briefing for any language model](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gorduan/DeepTip/main/docs/prompt.md): what DeepTip means and how to build it, in one page
- [Specification](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gorduan/DeepTip/main/SPEC.md): data format, behaviour, placement, input, accessibility, options, porting checklist
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gorduan/DeepTip/main/README.md): the pattern, the frameworks, the tools
- [Agent instructions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gorduan/DeepTip/main/AGENTS.md): how to add DeepTip to a project or port it to a new framework
